content: To construct target sequences for training INLINEFORM0 and INLINEFORM1 , ground truth keyphrases are sorted by their order of first occurrence in the source text. Keyphrases that do not appear in the source text are appended to the end. This order may guide the attention mechanism to attend to source positions in a smoother way. Implementation details can be found in Appendix SECREF9 .
